heroSubtitle: Terra Preta Organics develops soil amendments that restore soil function on degraded reclamation sites across Canada.

story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Soil function is an integrated set of biological, physical, and chemical processes that enable self-sustaining vegetation. When heavy equipment compacts soil or topsoil sits stockpiled for years, these processes break down. Native species struggle to establish. Sites fail inspections. Operators face costly re-mobilizations and delayed closure.

We founded Terra Preta Organics to solve this problem. Our flagship product, Terra Revive, rebuilds soil biology and structure so native species establish without synthetics. Applied at 2,000+ lbs per acre, the pellets integrate into the soil profile and support long-term vegetation establishment.

We work with reclamation consultants, EPCs, and operational decision makers who need reliable outcomes and spec-grade documentation. Our goal is to help sites close faster and reduce long-term liability.

items.title: Manufacturing in Sundre, Alberta
items.description: Our facility in Sundre produces Terra Revive pellets using consistent formulations and quality-controlled processes. We maintain inventory to support Canada-wide delivery.

items.title: Quality assurance
items.description: Every batch is tested for moisture content, particle size, and ingredient consistency. We provide batch-specific QA documentation and maintain traceability for all shipments.
